notes: Summary: mid-market analytics SaaS evaluating Redwood Hosted -> Dedicated. Started with Hosted API PoC for embeddings + support chat; now leaning Dedicated for predictable throughput and VPC isolation. Product lead: Aaron Myers (Head of Product) — quote: 'we can't have multi-second tails during peak support hours; SLA must be predictable.' Security: heavy — must pass internal ProdSec and legal for Dedicated (SOC2 type II preferred, SAML/Okta integration, 1 year audit log retention, KMS for keys, EU data residency for subset of customers). Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to commit to reserved capacity if ROI on per-token cost < 30% of current infra spend. POC notes: 2-week PoC used hosted rtx-model-1; average 95p latency 180ms for <1k concurrent users but spikes observed during long-context chat. Request: baseline perf cert + recommended quantized models for embeddings and chat; show fallback policy for capacity/burst. Action items: send Dedicated architecture diagram, SOC2 report, SAML setup guide, initial pricing quote for 12mo reserved + 3mo trial burst. AE notes: keep messages short for execs, include cost model spreadsheet.
use_case_summary: Primary: document search + semantic embeddings (10M vectors target); secondary: support-chat assistant (context window 8k) and automated summarization for release notes. Need reranking for search results; batch reindex nightly. Traffic pattern: steady daytime traffic with 2x spikes during product launches. Latency target: 95th < 200ms for chat responses, embeddings < 150ms per request when using Dedicated. Throughput target: sustained 100 qps for embeddings peak, burst to 400 qps for short periods.
requirements_summary: Security: SOC2 Type II report, SAML SSO (Okta), KMS integration, audit logs exported to customer SIEM, retention controls (1 year) and option to shorten retention for privacy. Network: VPC peering, static IPs for egress allowlisting, TLS in transit, encrypted at rest. Operational: canary rollouts, model pinning, throttles per-route, cost telemetry for token-level breakdown. Data residency: subset of EU customers must keep vectors + PII in EU region. Compliance: exportable audit logs and monthly access reports.
poc_plan: Phase 1 (Hosted PoC - completed): validate embeddings quality and integration latency (2 weeks). Phase 2 (Dedicated PoC - proposed 3 weeks): dedicated GPU pool in us-east with VPC peering, run synthetic load to validate 95p latency and KV caching, test SAML SSO, verify audit log exports. Success criteria: sustained 95p latency < 200ms under 100 qps, audit logs present in customer Splunk instance within 5 minutes, Okta SAML SSO working for 10 test users, cost model within target ARR band. Post-POC: procurement + contract (12mo reserved) if pass ProdSec + Finance signoff.
